result.title: Lean Census: A Distributional Analysis of AI-Generated Lean Code
result.summary: We compare two human-written and four AI-generated Lean libraries with Mathlib through the distributions of simple statistics of their code. For each library we measure inline claims in proofs, proof length, how often each declaration is used, and design choices such as instances and private declarations, and we read each against the variation among Mathlib's own areas. The AI-generated libraries have more inline claims per theorem, longer proofs, fewer instances, and more private declarations than the human-written ones. We release the code for the analysis as a package, lean-census, at https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用统计量分布对比两个人工与四个 AI 生成的 Lean 库与 Mathlib，考察证明内联断言、证明长度、声明复用率及 instance/private 等设计选择，并发布分析代码包 lean-census。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是形式化证明代码的分布统计，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的内部状态、证据获取或停止决策，也未提供可迁移至 LVR 的状态或训练线索。
